figurative_meaning_en: The sound of a heavy object falling with a dull thud
example_sentences_in_bangla: বইগুলো ঘাতঘোত শব্দে মেঝেতে পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He fell to the ground with a thud.
The books hit the floor with a heavy thud.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression rooted in Bengali phonetic traditions for describing physical impacts.
